name: ADTRAN, Inc.
summary:
ADTRAN (ADTN) reported earnings of $0.04 per share on revenue of $281.15 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.04 per share on revenue of $293.26 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.05 per share. The company missed expectations by 20.00% while revenue grew 6.07% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects third quarter revenue of $275.0 million to $295.0 million. The current consensus revenue estimate is $298.9 million for the quarter ending September 30, 2026.

ADTRAN Holdings, Inc. is the parent company of Adtran, Inc., a leading global provider of open, disaggregated networking and communications solutions that enable voice, data, video and internet communications across any network infrastructure.
subject: ADTRAN Missed Expectations
